title: The Lantern Lit by the Sun First
youtube_title: The Lantern Lit by the Sun First | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A small beautiful thing can be shared with the eyes only.
summary: At a harbor wall at low tide, Cosima finds a lantern glass lighting up from the sun before any match. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Cosima shows Zola how to look without disturbing it. the ferryman looks too, and they leave it where it is.
